name: tsa_validateSession
description: Validates a worker session cookie: if the session exists and is unexpired, stamps lastSeenAt and returns the worker identity when the worker is Active. Returns NO result set at all for an unknown or expired session (caller treats as unauthenticated), and an empty rowset for a suspended worker. Called by the TSA Eats Next.js app (tsa-eats/lib/api.ts) through api/Endpoints/TsaApi.cs, which maps queryType 'validateSession' to [TSA].[tsa_validateSession]. There is no Harrier Central auth: POST requires the shared X-Api-Key (TsaApiKey); GET requires nothing, and the shim does not restrict which procedure a GET may name. The shim turns any one-row rowset with Success = 0 into HTTP 400 {success:false, errorMessage}, and an empty first rowset into HTTP 404.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: Session id from the httpOnly tsa_session cookie. No default.

rowsets.name: Worker
rowsets.description: Only when the session is valid: zero rows if the worker is not Active, else one row.

sideEffects: UPDATE TSA.Session SET lastSeenAt = now (also for a suspended worker's session).

codeSmells.detail: @sessionId (line 2) have no SQL default. A caller that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the body runs: no log row, and the TsaApi shim returns a generic 500.

codeSmells.issue: SP body not wrapped in TRY/CATCH
codeSmells.detail: Read procedure with no TRY/CATCH: any runtime error (timeout, deadlock) becomes an unlogged raw 500 from the shim.
The header (line 6) says 'sliding window', but only lastSeenAt is updated; expiresAt stays fixed at creation + 90 days.
Invalid session returns no result set (line 20); a suspended worker returns an empty rowset. Both reach the client as 404 only because the shim treats an empty first rowset that way.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
